overlays.notes: Measured 2026-07-13 from the protocol's own stats API: total collateral value $71,324,392 against total BOLD supply 29,047,740 gives a system collateralization ratio of 2.455; Stability Pool deposits of 19,111,283 BOLD against the same supply give a liquidation capacity ratio of 0.658. Collateralization parameters and Stability Pool liquidation mechanics are documented protocol design reviewed against the docs; backstop, branch isolation, shutdown/bad-debt, and structural redemption are left bounded-unknown pending a dedicated review even though redemption and per-branch isolation are documented features.
